introHtml: Custom pouches with carabiner offer a convenient hands-free carry solution for keys, ID badges, or small tools. The built-in clip lets recipients attach the pouch to belts, bags, or lanyards, making it a practical giveaway for trade shows, corporate events, or safety teams. Choose from nylon, canvas, or polyester options and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for lasting brand visibility.
